rules.overlap: per task the 8 C115 ids with the smallest sha256('kv-discard C127 full-set overlap 2026-10|' + id); run first, round-robin over the 13 tasks (sorted names); new arm-C rows on these ids serve the reproduction check only
rules.new_order: the 3,900 ids outside the C115 list, per task by sha256('kv-discard C127 full-set order 2026-10|' + id), round-robin over tasks
rules.av_ids: the 13 C115 z_ids (1 per task); bare RestoreKV_plus at the start of every sandbox, gated against the C115 arm-A rows
rules.partitions: C115 ids (2,600; arm C reused from rows_c115_final.jsonl if the reuse rule passes), used (1,912 = C115 exclusion union), never_used (1,988 = remainder; per-item rows sealed, aggregates only)
